[
  {
    "obligated_party": "Contractor",
    "obligation": "Cycle-count all SKUs in Warehouse B",
    "amount": null,
    "deadline": "October 15, 2026",
    "source_quote": "Contractor shall cycle-count all SKUs in Warehouse B on or before October 15, 2026, and deliver the count report to Client within two business days of completion."
  },
  {
    "obligated_party": "Contractor",
    "obligation": "Provide a certificate of insurance to Client before work begins",
    "amount": null,
    "deadline": "before work begins",
    "source_quote": "Contractor shall carry general liability insurance of $1,000,000 and provide a certificate of insurance to Client before work begins."
  },
  {
    "obligated_party": "Client",
    "obligation": "Pay Contractor a flat fee of $2,500.00",
    "amount": "2500.00",
    "deadline": "within net 30 days of receipt of invoice",
    "source_quote": "Client shall pay Contractor a flat fee of $2,500.00 within net 30 days of receipt of invoice."
  },
  {
    "obligated_party": "Contractor",
    "obligation": "Reconcile all inventory variances over $500.00 with Client's finance contact",
    "amount": null,
    "deadline": "before month-end close",
    "source_quote": "Contractor shall reconcile all inventory variances over $500.00 with Client's finance contact before month-end close."
  },
  {
    "obligated_party": "Contractor",
    "obligation": "Not disclose Client's inventory data to any third party",
    "amount": null,
    "deadline": "during the term and for 12 months after it ends",
    "source_quote": "Contractor shall not disclose Client's inventory data to any third party during the term and for 12 months after it ends."
  },
  {
    "obligated_party": "Either party",
    "obligation": "Terminate this agreement with 14 days' written notice to the other party",
    "amount": null,
    "deadline": "with 14 days' written notice",
    "source_quote": "Either party may terminate this agreement with 14 days' written notice to the other party."
  }
]
